local p = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui", p.PlayerGui)
g.Name = "AnimToggle"
g.ResetOnSpawn = false

local main = Instance.new("Frame", g)
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 70)
main.Position = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0.5, -35)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)
Instance.new("UICorner", main)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", main)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
title.Text = "  Anim Controller"
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45,45,45)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 12
Instance.new("UICorner", title)

local btnMin = Instance.new("TextButton", title)
btnMin.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
btnMin.Position = UDim2.new(1, -22, 0, 0)
btnMin.Text = "-"
btnMin.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70,70,70)
btnMin.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
btnMin.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
btnMin.TextScaled = true
Instance.new("UICorner", btnMin)

local b = Instance.new("TextButton", main)
b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 25)
b.Text = "ANIM: OFF"
b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80,80,80)
b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
b.TextScaled = true
Instance.new("UICorner", b)

-- DRAG & MINIMIZE
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true dragStart = input.Position startPos = main.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function() if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end end)
	end
end)
title.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragInput = input end
end)
game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input == dragInput and dragging then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)

local minimized = false
btnMin.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	minimized = not minimized
	if minimized then main.Size = UDim2.new(0,140,0,20) b.Visible=false btnMin.Text="+" 
	else main.Size = UDim2.new(0,140,0,70) b.Visible=true btnMin.Text="-" end
end)

-- ANIM + FOOTSTEP
local IDLE = "rbxassetid://112916477760662"
local WALK = "rbxassetid://95388940645239"
local RUN = "rbxassetid://119327996325377"
local FOOTSTEP_ID = "rbxassetid://137620518840395"

local enabled = false
local curTrack, conn, stepConn
local tracks = {}
local stepSound = nil

local function stopAll()
	if curTrack then curTrack:Stop(0.15) curTrack=nil end
	if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn=nil end
	if stepConn then stepConn:Disconnect() stepConn=nil end
	for _, t in pairs(tracks) do pcall(function() t:Stop(0.15) end) end
	tracks = {}
	if stepSound then stepSound:Stop() end
end

local function createFootstepSound(root)
	if stepSound then stepSound:Destroy() end
	stepSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	stepSound.Name = "Footstep"
	stepSound.SoundId = FOOTSTEP_ID
	stepSound.Volume = 1
	stepSound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
	stepSound.Parent = root
end

local function loadAll(hum)
	stopAll()
	local char = hum.Parent
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local animator = hum:WaitForChild("Animator")
	
	createFootstepSound(root)
	
	local function make(id)
		local a = Instance.new("Animation") a.AnimationId = id
		return animator:LoadAnimation(a)
	end
	tracks.Idle = make(IDLE) tracks.Walk = make(WALK) tracks.Run = make(RUN)
	for _, t in pairs(tracks) do t.Looped = true t.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement end
end

local function play(name)
	if not enabled then return end
	if not tracks[name] then return end
	if curTrack == tracks[name] then return end
	if curTrack then curTrack:Stop(0.15) end
	curTrack = tracks[name] curTrack:Play(0.15)
end

local function hookHumanoid(hum)
	loadAll(hum)
	if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
	if stepConn then stepConn:Disconnect() end
	
	local lastStep = 0
	conn = hum.Running:Connect(function(s)
		if not enabled then return end
		if s < 0.1 then 
			play("Idle")
		elseif s < 16 then 
			play("Walk") 
		else 
			play("Run") 
		end
	end)
	
	-- FOOTSTEP LOOP
	stepConn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not enabled or not stepSound then return end
		if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
			local speed = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude * hum.WalkSpeed
			local interval = speed > 16 and 0.25 or 0.4 -- lari lebih cepet bunyinya
			if tick() - lastStep >= interval then
				lastStep = tick()
				stepSound:Play()
			end
		end
	end)
	
	play("Idle")
end

b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	enabled = not enabled
	if enabled then
		b.Text = "ANIM: ON" b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,170,0)
		local char = p.Character or p.CharacterAdded:Wait()
		hookHumanoid(char:WaitForChild("Humanoid"))
	else
		b.Text = "ANIM: OFF" b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80,80,80)
		stopAll()
	end
end)

p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.wait(0.5)
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	if enabled then hookHumanoid(hum) end
end)

scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for Legends Battlegrounds uses FishyUI and opens with RightShift, organizing combat, farming, visuals, movement, defense, misc, and settings into separate tabs. Combat tools cover hit-list injection, auto M1 with click, hold, or direct modes, click-rate and cooldown controls, whiff-punish removal, forced downslam, targeting filters, FOV circle display, lock-on hijacking, and a real hitbox preview. The auto kill farm parks behind a chosen target, leads moving opponents, locks onto one player by name through deaths and respawns, pauses between kills, gates swings intelligently, and optionally uses skill slots and awakening. Additional farm options handle destroyables and reward claims, while visuals provide player ESP with boxes, names, distance, health, state tags, chams, and tracers. Performance tools include a one-press FPS boost, a destructive potato mode, shadow and post-FX removal, texture stripping, terrain flattening, cloth-sim disabling, ragdoll-pool clearing, character-sound muting, quality selection, and an FPS cap. Movement features cover walk-speed and jump-height overrides, infinite jump, noclip, fly, infinite sprint, dash spam, and stepped teleports. Defense includes auto block, anti-fling, anti-ragdoll, stun stripping, anti-slow, anti-freeze, anti-void recovery, client-state clearing, and manual awakening. Misc and settings add anti-AFK, rejoin and server hop, local UI unlocks, remote spy logging, theme/config saving, and full cleanup on unload.

scripts.title: Pixels Hub
scripts.script:
--========================================================
-- PIXEL CAMOUFLAGE + ESP CHAMELEON
-- Modern Professional UI | R6 / R15
-- Client-side LocalScript
--========================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--========================================================
-- CONFIGURATION
--========================================================

local FIGURE_NAMES = {
    PixelFigure = true,
    PaintDummy = true,
}

local PAINTING_NAME = "PixelPainting"
local BLOCK_NAME = "Block"
local BODY_NAME = "Body"

local ESP_MODEL_PATH = {
    "ChameleonOpponent",
    "Figure",
}

local MAX_PLANE_DISTANCE = 8

local ESP_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
local ESP_FILL_TRANSPARENCY = 0.15
local ESP_OUTLINE_TRANSPARENCY = 0

--========================================================
-- UI THEME
--========================================================

local THEME = {
    Background = Color3.fromRGB(17, 19, 29),
    Surface = Color3.fromRGB(25, 29, 43),
    SurfaceLight = Color3.fromRGB(34, 39, 56),

    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(139, 92, 246),
    AccentLight = Color3.fromRGB(167, 139, 250),
    Cyan = Color3.fromRGB(45, 212, 191),

    Text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 255),
    Muted = Color3.fromRGB(155, 165, 187),

    Green = Color3.fromRGB(16, 185, 129),
    Red = Color3.fromRGB(239, 83, 103),

    Border = Color3.fromRGB(57, 64, 86),
}

--========================================================
-- STATE
--========================================================

local originalAppearance = {}
local paintedParts = {}
local espHighlight

local espEnabled = false
local draggingEnabled = true
local panelVisible = true

local screenGui
local mainFrame
local statusLabel
local espButton
local camouflageButton
local hideButton
local showButton

local espConnection
local dragConnection

--========================================================
-- HELPERS
--========================================================

local function isBasePart(instance)
    return instance and instance:IsA("BasePart")
end

local function getAllParts(root)
    local result = {}

    if not root then
        return result
    end

    for _, instance in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
            table.insert(result, instance)
        end
    end

    return result
end

local function getNamedParts(root, wantedName)
    local result = {}

    if not root then
        return result
    end

    for _, instance in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if instance:IsA("BasePart")
            and instance.Name == wantedName then
            table.insert(result, instance)
        end
    end

    return result
end

local function findNamedModels()
    local result = {}

    for _, instance in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if instance:IsA("Model")
            and FIGURE_NAMES[instance.Name] then
            table.insert(result, instance)
        end
    end

    return result
end

local function getPaintings()
    local result = {}

    for _, instance in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if instance:IsA("Model")
            and instance.Name == PAINTING_NAME then
            table.insert(result, instance)
        end
    end

    return result
end

local function setStatus(message)
    if statusLabel and statusLabel.Parent then
        statusLabel.Text = message
    end
end

--========================================================
-- SAVE AND RESTORE ORIGINAL APPEARANCE
--========================================================

local function saveOriginal(part)
    if originalAppearance[part] then
        return
    end

    local data = {
        Color = part.Color,
        Material = part.Material,
        MaterialVariant = part.MaterialVariant,
        TextureObjects = {},
    }

    for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Texture") or child:IsA("Decal") then
            data.TextureObjects[child] = {
                Color3 = child.Color3,
                Transparency = child.Transparency,
            }
        end
    end

    originalAppearance[part] = data
end

local function paintBody(part, color)
    if not isBasePart(part) or not part.Parent then
        return
    end

    saveOriginal(part)

    part.Color = color
    part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic

    for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Texture") or child:IsA("Decal") then
            child.Color3 = color
        end
    end

    paintedParts[part] = true
end

local function restoreAll()
    for part, data in pairs(originalAppearance) do
        if part and part.Parent then
            part.Color = data.Color
            part.Material = data.Material

            pcall(function()
                part.MaterialVariant = data.MaterialVariant
            end)

            for texture, textureData in pairs(data.TextureObjects) do
                if texture and texture.Parent == part then
                    texture.Color3 = textureData.Color3
                    texture.Transparency = textureData.Transparency
                end
            end
        end
    end

    table.clear(originalAppearance)
    table.clear(paintedParts)
end

--========================================================
-- PROJECT PART INTO PAINTING SPACE
--========================================================

local function getProjectedBounds(part, paintingCFrame)
    local half = part.Size * 0.5

    local minX, maxX = math.huge, -math.huge
    local minY, maxY = math.huge, -math.huge
    local minZ, maxZ = math.huge, -math.huge

    for _, sx in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
        for _, sy in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
            for _, sz in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
                local cornerLocal = Vector3.new(
                    half.X * sx,
                    half.Y * sy,
                    half.Z * sz
                )

                local cornerWorld =
                    part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(cornerLocal)

                local p =
                    paintingCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(cornerWorld)

                minX = math.min(minX, p.X)
                maxX = math.max(maxX, p.X)
                minY = math.min(minY, p.Y)
                maxY = math.max(maxY, p.Y)
                minZ = math.min(minZ, p.Z)
                maxZ = math.max(maxZ, p.Z)
            end
        end
    end

    return {
        minX = minX,
        maxX = maxX,
        minY = minY,
        maxY = maxY,
        minZ = minZ,
        maxZ = maxZ,
        centerZ = (minZ + maxZ) * 0.5,
        width = maxX - minX,
        height = maxY - minY,
    }
end

--========================================================
-- RECTANGLE OVERLAP
--========================================================

local function getOverlapArea(a, b)
    local overlapX = math.max(
        0,
        math.min(a.maxX, b.maxX)
            - math.max(a.minX, b.minX)
    )

    local overlapY = math.max(
        0,
        math.min(a.maxY, b.maxY)
            - math.max(a.minY, b.minY)
    )

    return overlapX * overlapY
end

local function getPlaneGap(a, b)
    if a.maxZ < b.minZ then
        return b.minZ - a.maxZ
    elseif b.maxZ < a.minZ then
        return a.minZ - b.maxZ
    end

    return 0
end

--========================================================
-- FIND RELEVANT PAINTING
--========================================================

local function findPaintingForFigure(figure, paintings)
    local figureParts = getNamedParts(figure, BODY_NAME)

    if #figureParts == 0 then
        figureParts = getAllParts(figure)
    end

    if #figureParts == 0 then
        return nil
    end

    local figureCenter = figure:GetPivot().Position
    local bestPainting = nil
    local bestDistance = math.huge

    for _, painting in ipairs(paintings) do
        local blocks = getNamedParts(painting, BLOCK_NAME)

        if #blocks > 0 then
            local nearest = math.huge

            for _, block in ipairs(blocks) do
                local distance =
                    (block.Position - figureCenter).Magnitude

                if distance < nearest then
                    nearest = distance
                end
            end

            if nearest < bestDistance then
                bestDistance = nearest
                bestPainting = painting
            end
        end
    end

    return bestPainting
end

--========================================================
-- BUILD PIXEL DATA
--========================================================

local function buildPixelGrid(painting)
    local pixels = {}
    local paintingCFrame = painting:GetPivot()

    for _, block in ipairs(getNamedParts(painting, BLOCK_NAME)) do
        table.insert(pixels, {
            part = block,
            color = block.Color,
            bounds = getProjectedBounds(block, paintingCFrame),
        })
    end

    return pixels, paintingCFrame
end

--========================================================
-- CHOOSE PIXEL BY ACTUAL OVERLAP
--========================================================

local function findBestPixel(body, pixels, paintingCFrame)
    local bodyBounds = getProjectedBounds(body, paintingCFrame)

    local bestPixel = nil
    local bestArea = 0
    local bestGap = math.huge

    for _, pixel in ipairs(pixels) do
        local blockBounds = pixel.bounds
        local gap = getPlaneGap(bodyBounds, blockBounds)

        if gap <= MAX_PLANE_DISTANCE then
            local area = getOverlapArea(bodyBounds, blockBounds)

            if area > bestArea then
                bestArea = area
                bestGap = gap
                bestPixel = pixel

            elseif area > 0
                and math.abs(area - bestArea) < 0.0001
                and gap < bestGap then
                bestGap = gap
                bestPixel = pixel
            end
        end
    end

    if bestArea <= 0 then
        return nil
    end

    return bestPixel
end

--========================================================
-- APPLY CAMOUFLAGE
--========================================================

local function applyCamouflage()
    local figures = findNamedModels()
    local paintings = getPaintings()

    if #figures == 0 then
        setStatus("No PixelFigure/PaintDummy found")
        return
    end

    if #paintings == 0 then
        setStatus("No PixelPainting found")
        return
    end

    local paintedCount = 0
    local unmatchedCount = 0

    for _, figure in ipairs(figures) do
        local painting =
            findPaintingForFigure(figure, paintings)

        if painting then
            local pixels, paintingCFrame =
                buildPixelGrid(painting)

            local bodies = getNamedParts(figure, BODY_NAME)

            for _, body in ipairs(bodies) do
                if body.Transparency < 1 then
                    local pixel = findBestPixel(
                        body,
                        pixels,
                        paintingCFrame
                    )

                    if pixel then
                        paintBody(body, pixel.color)
                        paintedCount += 1
                    else
                        unmatchedCount += 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    setStatus(
        "Applied: " .. paintedCount
        .. " | No overlap: " .. unmatchedCount
    )
end

--========================================================
-- ESP CHAMELEON
--========================================================

local function findESPTarget()
    local current = workspace

    for _, name in ipairs(ESP_MODEL_PATH) do
        current = current:FindFirstChild(name)

        if not current then
            return nil
        end
    end

    return current
end

local function removeESP()
    if espHighlight then
        espHighlight:Destroy()
        espHighlight = nil
    end
end

local function updateESP()
    if not espEnabled then
        removeESP()
        return
    end

    local target = findESPTarget()

    if not target then
        removeESP()
        return
    end

    if espHighlight and espHighlight.Parent ~= target then
        removeESP()
    end

    if not espHighlight then
        espHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        espHighlight.Name = "PixelCamouflageESP"
        espHighlight.Adornee = target
        espHighlight.Parent = target
    end

    espHighlight.Enabled = true
    espHighlight.FillColor = ESP_COLOR
    espHighlight.OutlineColor = ESP_COLOR
    espHighlight.FillTransparency = ESP_FILL_TRANSPARENCY
    espHighlight.OutlineTransparency = ESP_OUTLINE_TRANSPARENCY
    espHighlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
end

--========================================================
-- UI HELPERS
--========================================================

local function addCorner(object, radius)
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
    corner.Parent = object
    return corner
end

local function addStroke(object, color, thickness, transparency)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = color
    stroke.Thickness = thickness or 1
    stroke.Transparency = transparency or 0
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    stroke.Parent = object
    return stroke
end

local function addGradient(object, colorA, colorB, rotation)
    local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, colorA),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, colorB),
    })
    gradient.Rotation = rotation or 0
    gradient.Parent = object
    return gradient
end

local function makeLabel(
    parent,
    name,
    text,
    size,
    position,
    color,
    font,
    textSize
)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Name = name
    label.Size = size
    label.Position = position
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text
    label.TextColor3 = color
    label.Font = font or Enum.Font.Gotham
    label.TextSize = textSize or 13
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    label.Parent = parent

    return label
end

--========================================================
-- UI CREATION
--========================================================

local function createUI()
    local old = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("PixelCamouflageUI")

    if old then
        old:Destroy()
    end

    screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    screenGui.Name = "PixelCamouflageUI"
    screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = false

    showButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    showButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 12)
    showButton.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Background
    showButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    showButton.Text = "🎨"
    showButton.TextColor3 = THEME.Text
    showButton.TextSize = 27
    showButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

    addStroke(showButton, THEME.Green, 2, 0)

    --====================================================
    -- CAMOUFLAGE BUTTON PRESS EFFECT
    --====================================================

    local normalCamouflageColor = THEME.SurfaceLight
    local pressedCamouflageColor = THEME.Green
    local camouflagePressed = false

    local function restoreCamouflageButton()
        if not camouflageButton or not camouflageButton.Parent then
            return
        end

        camouflagePressed = false
        camouflageButton.BackgroundColor3 = normalCamouflageColor
    end

    camouflageButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            camouflagePressed = true
            camouflageButton.BackgroundColor3 = pressedCamouflageColor
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            if camouflagePressed then
                restoreCamouflageButton()
            end
        end
    end)

    camouflageButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        local originalText = camouflageButton.Text

        camouflageButton.Text = "⏳  APPLYING..."

        task.defer(function()
            local success, err = pcall(applyCamouflage)

            if not success then
                warn("[PixelCamouflage] " .. tostring(err))
                setStatus("Error applying camouflage")
            end

            if camouflageButton and camouflageButton.Parent then
                camouflageButton.Text = originalText
                restoreCamouflageButton()
            end
        end)
    end)

    --====================================================
    -- ESP SWITCH
    --====================================================

    local function refreshESPButton()
        espButton.Text = "ESP CHAMELEON"

        local oldSwitch = espButton:FindFirstChild("Switch")

        if oldSwitch then
            oldSwitch:Destroy()
        end

        local switch = Instance.new("Frame")
        switch.Name = "Switch"
        switch.Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 22)
        switch.Position = UDim2.new(1, -53, 0.5, -11)
        switch.BorderSizePixel = 0

        switch.BackgroundColor3 = espEnabled
            and THEME.Green
            or THEME.Border

        switch.Parent = espButton

        addCorner(switch, 20)

        local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
        knob.Name = "Knob"
        knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)

        knob.Position = espEnabled
            and UDim2.new(1, -19, 0.5, -8)
            or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8)

        knob.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Text
        knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
        knob.Parent = switch

        addCorner(knob, 20)

        if espEnabled then
            espButton.BackgroundColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(24, 91, 79)

            espButton.TextColor3 =
                Color3.fromRGB(153, 255, 222)

            updateESP()
        else
            espButton.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.SurfaceLight
            espButton.TextColor3 = THEME.Text

            removeESP()
        end
    end

    espButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        espEnabled = not espEnabled
        refreshESPButton()
    end)

    --====================================================
    -- HIDE / SHOW PANEL
    --====================================================

    hideButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        panelVisible = false
        mainFrame.Visible = false
        showButton.Visible = true
    end)

    local showDragged = false

    showButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        if showDragged then
            return
        end

        panelVisible = true
        mainFrame.Visible = true
        showButton.Visible = false
    end)

    --====================================================
    -- DRAG FLOATING SHOW BUTTON
    --====================================================

    local showDragStart
    local showStartPosition
    local showActiveInput

    showButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if not draggingEnabled then
            return
        end

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            showActiveInput = input
            showDragStart = input.Position
            showStartPosition = showButton.Position
            showDragged = false
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not draggingEnabled
            or not showDragStart
            or not showStartPosition then
            return
        end

        local isMouseMove =
            showActiveInput
            and showActiveInput.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            and input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement

        local isTouchMove =
            showActiveInput
            and showActiveInput.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            and input == showActiveInput

        if isMouseMove or isTouchMove then
            local delta = input.Position - showDragStart

            if delta.Magnitude > 5 then
                showDragged = true
            end

            showButton.Position = UDim2.new(
                showStartPosition.X.Scale,
                showStartPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
                showStartPosition.Y.Scale,
                showStartPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if showActiveInput and (
            input == showActiveInput
            or input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        ) then
            showDragStart = nil
            showActiveInput = nil

            if showDragged then
                task.delay(0.2, function()
                    showDragged = false
                end)
            end
        end
    end)

    --====================================================
    -- DRAG MAIN PANEL WITH MOUSE OR TOUCH
    --====================================================

    local dragStart
    local startPosition
    local activeInput

    mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if not draggingEnabled then
            return
        end

        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            activeInput = input
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPosition = mainFrame.Position
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not draggingEnabled or not dragStart then
            return
        end

        local isMouseMove =
            activeInput
            and activeInput.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            and input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement

        local isTouchMove =
            activeInput
            and activeInput.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            and input == activeInput

        if isMouseMove or isTouchMove then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart

            mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPosition.X.Scale,
                startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPosition.Y.Scale,
                startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if activeInput and (
            input == activeInput
            or input.UserInputType
                == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        ) then
            dragStart = nil
            activeInput = nil
        end
    end)

    refreshESPButton()
end

--========================================================
-- CHAT COMMAND: UNNO
--========================================================

local function onChatMessage(message)
    if string.upper(message) == "UNNO" then
        draggingEnabled = not draggingEnabled

        if draggingEnabled then
            setStatus("Panel dragging: ON")
        else
            setStatus("Panel dragging: LOCKED")
        end
    end
end

Player.Chatted:Connect(onChatMessage)

--========================================================
-- INITIALIZE
--========================================================

createUI()

updateESP()

espConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if espEnabled then
        updateESP()
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- CLEANUP
--========================================================

screenGui.Destroying:Connect(function()
    restoreAll()
    removeESP()

    if espConnection then
        espConnection:Disconnect()
        espConnection = nil
    end
end)

comments.text: @cvexe so ive found a possible reason why the bullets are missing - the aim point is chosen right before the shot has actually been created and shot so the shot could miss as its shooting at where it was right before the bullet was shot, the fall back also counts missed shots due to spread (which can be set to zero spread) as failed headshots so it could cause it to target torso when it should be targeting the head, ive changed it to now the aimpoint is set at the time the shot is fired so it should now no longer miss (providing the npc has a valid head hitbox as some dont, hence the fallback) hitscan has also been set to on by default, also added player esp GUI next to the Map button on the visual enhancements tab.
